title: Clone a script's "error to rethrow" before exposing it to the page

labels.name: needs tests
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires someone to write tests

body:
The fact that we stored the actual object was just for specification
convenience, but had observable consequences by demanding that the same
object be exposed repeatedly. Cloning allows a bit more implementation
flexibility.

/cc @whatwg/modules. Tests will come from Chrome; in https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/698467 we noted this requirement was too strict and so held off writing tests for it, so now we'll write tests for the opposite (i.e. that they are always distinct).
